title: docs: add marked-gitlab to known extensions
body:
## Description

Add [marked-gitlab](https://www.npmjs.com/package/marked-gitlab) to known extensions

## Contributor

- [ ] Test(s) exist to ensure functionality and minimize regression (if no tests added, list tests covering this PR); or,
- [ ] no tests required for this PR.
- [x] If submitting new feature, it has been documented in the appropriate places.

## Committer

In most cases, this should be a different person than the contributor.

- [ ] CI is green (no forced merge required).
- [ ] Squash and Merge PR following [conventional commit guidelines](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
